lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A loose grid of high-luminance circular clusters is visible on the posterior flank (left side of frame), showing a decrease in spot diameter and an increase in density as the pattern moves toward the cephalic region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity are discernible, intersecting with horizontal spot rows to form structured nodes, particularly distinct in the region immediately posterior to the gill slits.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear ridge is visible running from the posterior gill margin toward the tail, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high intensity on the dorsal side and a defined shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: Dense, high-frequency speckling of small high-luminance points across the broad dorsal surface of the snout and head, contrasting with the larger, more structured spots on the lateral flank.
